name: Token bucket
summary: Spend from a balance that refills at a steady rate and stops at a burst. Continuous refill, no window seam, and an exact retry hint: the default rate limiter.

complexity.space: O(k) for k keys, three integers each

params.name: burst
params.description: Maximum tokens a key can hold, and so the largest burst it can spend.

notes: At equal parameters this is the leaky bucket exactly, under the substitution tokens = capacity - level. A vector in each policy pins the equivalence. The ledger is integer arithmetic with a thousandths-of-a-token carry, so the three ports decide identically.
